command:
set -eu
cp -a /etc/rsyncd.conf /etc/rsyncd.conf.pre-releases
cat > /etc/rsyncd.conf <<'ANTRIEB_RSYNC_CONF'
uid = nobody
gid = nobody
use chroot = yes
max connections = 4
pid file = /run/rsyncd.pid
lock file = /run/rsyncd.lock
transfer logging = yes
timeout = 300

[releases]
    path = /srv/legacy2/rsync-module-publication/releases
    comment = Approved legacy release tree
    read only = yes
    list = yes
    hosts allow = 10.100.230.11
    hosts deny = *
ANTRIEB_RSYNC_CONF
cat > /etc/systemd/system/rsyncd.service <<'ANTRIEB_RSYNC_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Read-only rsync daemon for approved releases
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/rsync --daemon --no-detach --config=/etc/rsyncd.conf
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2s
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
NoNewPrivileges=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_RSYNC_UNIT
restorecon -v /etc/rsyncd.conf /etc/systemd/system/rsyncd.service
setsebool -P rsync_export_all_ro on
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now rsyncd.service
firewall-cmd --permanent --add-rich-rule='rule family="ipv4" source address="10.100.230.11" port port="873" protocol="tcp" accept'
firewall-cmd --reload
